storySurfacePolish.firstCallSummary: The buyer is testing whether the branch can make a believable availability promise before the order is placed.
storySurfacePolish.proofMove: Open the Product SKU, then use Branch Availability / Replenishment Flow and Fulfillment Support SKU records to show branch availability, replenishment timing, and fulfillment support in one NetSuite proof path.
storySurfacePolish.objectionResponse: If the buyer asks whether the promise is trustworthy, open the returned records and show the proof path first; then ask which branch, supplier handoff, or replenishment decision they would validate next.
storySurfacePolish.finalValueAnswer: Frame value as fewer missed promises, faster counter-sales decisions, better replenishment timing, and margin protection on urgent replacement orders.
storySurfacePolish.noClaimCaution: Do not claim manufacturing, WIP, routing, formula, ingredient, work order, measured ROI, record creation, write actions, or availability beyond returned records and confirmed buyer evidence.

agentResponsibilities.Connection Steward: Protect W144 submit, refresh/poll, validation, Finish build/import, and Open-link authority.
agentResponsibilities.Proof Architect: Own distribution proof record roles, names, labels, and proof-path shape.
agentResponsibilities.Story Strategist: Turn first-call notes into proof move, objection response, and value story.
agentResponsibilities.Vocabulary Guard: Block manufacturing/WIP leakage in distribution consultant-facing surfaces.
agentResponsibilities.QA Story Runner: Judge whether the live proof makes sense to a sales rep or SC.
